name: Efficient multiple scattering in hair using spherical harmonics
aliases: Spherical Harmonic Multiple Scattering in Hair
definition: A physically based multiple scattering simulation method for hair that exploits the smoothness of the multiple scattering distribution using a spherical harmonic basis to reduce computational cost while preserving directionally varying effects.
summary: This method computes physically based multiple scattering in hair volumes by representing incident radiance as spherical harmonic coefficients, enabling efficient evaluation via precomputed sparse matrix multiplication.
